purpose: Independent circuit-level Monte Carlo benchmark; not a reconstruction of the manuscript's missing original simulation.
crossing_method: Pairwise crossings of piecewise-linear log10 logical error rates; report median and observed range, not an FSS confidence interval.
zero_rate_policy: Exclude zero-rate rows from logarithmic crossing estimates and report them explicitly.
dependency_policy: Fail if Stim or PyMatching is unavailable; never substitute formula-generated logical error rates.
